title: 29.x: Allow bank rec. duplicated transactions surfaced in UI
summary: Bank Acc. Reconciliation and Payment Reconciliation Journal pages now expose an existing option to allow duplicated transactions when importing bank statements, such as SEPA CAMT files whose transaction IDs can repeat. Related captions were also made more precise.
key_points: Adds UI controls to surface existing duplicate transaction handling logic in bank reconciliation
Improves captions in reconciliation interfaces for clarity
Enables users to manage scenarios like SEPA CAMT imports with duplicate transaction IDs
Applies changes across W1, NA, and CH localization layers
quote: This change resurfaces this functionality, to give this option to users that need it.
